claim_boundary: This file is the canonical current-state pointer after the frozen six-source NEE routing gate passed and after a separate post-promotion source-robustness challenge closed unsuccessfully without opening any additional natural coordinates. The active submission frames novelty as determinant-ranking transportability / response sufficiency. NEE_candidate remains the output of the original frozen routing rule; the natural plane remains source-complementary and is not leave-any-source-out invariant. Natural Hill D1 is not synthetic k or k_eff, and no natural k≈4 threshold is claimed.
